name: password-input
title: Password Input
description: A password field with a button that shows and hides what was typed, a note when Caps Lock is on, and an optional list of the project's rules, each marked met or not met in words as the person types.

meta.when: Signing in (current-password) or choosing a password (new-password, with `rules`). For a one-time code use otp-input; for other secrets that must never be shown, a plain input of type password.
meta.example:
<PasswordInput
  aria-label="New password"
  autoComplete="new-password"
  rules={[
    { label: "At least 12 characters", test: (v) => v.length >= 12 },
    { label: "A number", test: (v) => /\d/.test(v) },
  ]}
/>
